issues.description: The problem statement's UML lists getTotalNumberOfStudents() as a public method (plus sign), but the solution implements it with protected visibility. This conflicts with the specification and may cause confusion or test failures if callers (or tests) expect to call this method from outside the package/class.
issues.suggestedFix: Make getTotalNumberOfStudents() public to match the UML and problem description (change 'protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' to 'public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()'). Ensure the template and solution both present the method with public visibility so students and tests can access it as specified.
